# Isaiah Chapter 50 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 11 verses]*

*Third Servant Song; back to those who strike; face like flint; who fears the LORD?*
